title: 7-day motor imagery BCI EEG dataset from Zhou et al 2021
description: A 7-day longitudinal motor imagery brain-computer interface (BCI) EEG dataset comprising 20 healthy participants performing four imagery tasks (left hand, right hand, feet, and rest) across 7 sessions. The dataset contains 33,600 trials recorded at 500 Hz from 41 EEG channels using a Neuroscan SynAmps2 system, with preprocessed data suitable for BCI algorithm development and motor imagery decoding research.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired at 500 Hz sampling rate from 41 channels using a Neuroscan SynAmps2 system with Ag/AgCl sensors referenced to vertex (Cz) and grounded at AFz. Online filtering included bandpass (0.5-100 Hz) and 50 Hz notch filtering. Participants performed motor imagery tasks cued by visual arrow stimuli in a synchronous, offline paradigm without feedback. Each session consisted of 6 runs with 40 trials per run, yielding 5-second trial intervals. Data were preprocessed and packaged in NPZ format using the Mother of All BCI Benchmarks (MOABB) framework for standardized BCI algorithm evaluation.
